title: Agentic Federated Learning: Rule-Based Client and Server Agents for Adaptive Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.35914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive applications such as healthcare, finance, and edge intelligence. However, conventional FL approaches rely on static client participation and fixed aggregation strategies, which limits their effectiveness under non-IID data distributions, heterogeneous client behavior, and noisy or unreliable updates. To overcome these issuess, this paper proposes an Agentic Federated Learning (AFL) framework that integrates lightweight rule-based autonomous agents at both client and server levels. The proposed framework introduces a Client-Side Agent (CSA) that dynamically adapts local training parameters, controls participa- tion, and evaluates update reliability, while a Server-Side Orchestrator Agent (SSOA) performs quality-aware client selection and adaptive aggregation. translated_title: 智能体联邦学习：基于规则的客户端与服务器智能体实现自适应训练
translated_abstract: 联邦学习能够在不共享原始数据的情况下实现跨分布式客户端的协作模型训练，使其适用于医疗、金融和边缘智能等隐私敏感型应用。然而，传统的联邦学习方法依赖静态的客户端参与和固定的聚合策略，这限制了其在非独立同分布数据分布、异构客户端行为以及噪声或不可靠更新场景下的有效性。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种智能体联邦学习框架，在客户端和服务器两个层面集成了轻量级的基于规则的自主智能体。该框架引入了客户端智能体，可动态调整本地训练参数、控制参与行为并评估更新的可靠性；同时，服务器端编排智能体执行质量感知的客户端选择和自适应聚合。与传统联邦学习方法不同……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出智能体联邦学习框架，通过客户端智能体动态调整本地训练参数与更新可靠性评估，以及服务器端编排智能体执行质量感知的客户端选择与自适应聚合，克服了传统联邦学习在非独立同分布数据和异构环境下的局限性。
